page.overview:
Who is Snails?

Snails is a male school-age unicorn pony who resides in Ponyville and is often seen with his friend Snips. He is called Snailsquirm in some merchandise.__TOC__

Snails is a golden colored colt with an aquamarine mane and tail and light yellow freckles, resembling Generation 1 baby pony Squirmy. He is notably lankier and thinner than other ponies, much like Celestia, Luna, Fleur Dis Lee, and Mr. Carrot Cake. His irises are usually not visible outside of My Little Pony: Pony Life, similarly to those of Snips, but they are sometimes visible in the IDW comics, varying between dark brown on 's story page 14 and dark blue on 's Hot Topic RE cover.

Snails has a goofy manner of speech which, in contrast to Snips' higher voice, is quite low and slow. This tone and his use of the word "eh" is reminiscent of a stereotypical Canadian accent.

Both Snails, as well as his best friend Snips, are named after the traditional nursery rhyme What Are Little Boys Made Of?. A version of the verse goes:
